component.name: GTKittorrent
component.summary: Modern GTK4 and Libadwaita frontend for qBittorrent

description.p: GTKittorrent is a modern, full-featured GTK4 and Libadwaita frontend for qBittorrent, designed to achieve feature parity with qBittorrent's official Qt desktop UI while following GNOME design conventions.

ul.li: Support for multiple instances, including automatic setup for local qbittorrent-nox or qbittorrent
Full torrent management, downloading, and bandwidth control
Detailed torrent inspection: logs, trackers, peers, and file selection
Clean and adaptive interface using Libadwaita
